description: This file contains shell script functions for managing git repository states, such as setting, saving, verifying, and comparing file contents in the worktree and index, as well as handling the repository head.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Prepares specified file content in the worktree and stages it in the index.

methods.name: save_state
methods.description: Saves the current content of a file in the worktree and index to auxiliary files for later comparison.

methods.name: set_and_save_state
methods.description: Sets new content for a file and then saves its state.

methods.name: verify_state
methods.description: Verifies that a file's worktree and index contents match expected values.

methods.name: verify_saved_state
methods.description: Verifies that a previously saved state matches the current state.

methods.name: save_head
methods.description: Stores the current commit hash in a temporary file.

methods.name: verify_saved_head
methods.description: Checks that the current HEAD matches the previously saved hash.
